Accessibility.description_en:
The workspace visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE (default): visible only to yourself and administrators within the workspace.
PUBLIC: visible to all users in the workspace

SourceId.description_en:
The source ID.

If the source type is Custom, this field has no restrictions.

If the source type is PAIFlow or TrainingService, the format is: 
```
region=<region_id>,workspaceId=<workspace_id>,kind=<kind>,id=<id>
```
region is the Alibaba Cloud region ID. workspaceId is the workspace ID. kind specifies the type. Valid values: PipelineRun (PAI workflow) and ServiceJob (training service). id is the unique identifier
SourceId.description_zh:
来源ID。

来源类型为Custom时，该字段不做限制。

来源为PAIFlow，TrainingService时，格式为 
```
region=<region_id>,workspaceId=<workspace_id>,kind=<kind>,id=<id>
```
region 为阿里云区域ID；workspacceId 为工作空间ID；kind为类型，取值：PipelineRun（PAIFlow工作流），ServiceJob（训练服务）；id 为唯一标识
SourceId.title: 来源ID

SourceType.description_en:
The model source type. Default value: Custom.

Custom: custom.
PAIFlow: PAI workflow.
TrainingService: PAI training service
SourceType.description_zh:
模型来源类型，默认为Custom。

Custom：自定义。
PAIFlow：PAI工作流。
TrainingService：PAI训练服务
SourceType.title: 来源类型

TrainingSpec.description_en: The training configuration. Used for fine-tuning and incremental training
TrainingSpec.description_zh: 训练配置。用于微调、增量训练的配置

Uri.description_en: The model version URI, which specifies the model storage location. This can be an HTTP(S) address of the model, such as `https://myweb.com/mymodel.tar.gz`. If the model is stored in OSS, the format is `oss://<bucket>.<endpoint>/object`. You can query the endpoint in the OSS console. Example: `oss://mybucket.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/mypath/`
Uri.description_zh: 模型版本URI，即模型存储位置。可以为模型的HTTP(S)地址，如：`https://myweb.com/mymodel.tar.gz`；若模型在OSS中，格式为`oss://<bucket>.<endpoint>/object`，endpoint可以在OSS控制台查询，样例：`oss://mybucket.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/mypath/`
Uri.title: 版本的URI

VersionName.description_en:
The model version, unique within the model. If not specified, the first version defaults to `0.1.0`, and subsequent versions increment the minor version number by 1. For example, the second version defaults to `0.2.0`.

The version number consists of a major version number, a minor version number, and a stage version number, separated by `.`. The major and minor version numbers are numeric. The stage version number starts with a digit, followed by `_` and letters. Examples: 1.1.0 or 2.3.4_beta.

Regular expression reference: `"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(_\w+)?$"`
VersionName.description_zh:
模型版本，模型下唯一。若不填，则默认`0.1.0`为第一个版本，之后子版本号加1，如第二个版本将默认为`0.2.0`。

版本号由主版本号，子版本号，阶段版本号组成，由`.`分割，其中主版本号，子版本号为数字，阶段版本号以数字开头，接`_`加字母组成。如：1.1.0 或 2.3.4_beta。

正则表达参考：`"^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+(_\\w+)?$"`
VersionName.title: 版本名，模型下唯一

kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace list-models --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order DESC --sort-by GmtCreateTime --workspace-id 32400 --model-name Sentiment_analysis --label key1 --provider pai --domain nlp --task text-classification --origin ModelScope --query nlp --model-type Endpoint --collections AI4D,QuickStart --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --conditions Operator=LessThan Column=ParameterSize Value=3000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModels

parameters.help_en: The page number of the model list. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 模型列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of models to display on each page in a paged query. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的模型数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The order in which to sort the results of a paged query. The default value is ASC.

ASC: ascending order.

DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。默认ASC。
ASC：升序。
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The field to use for sorting in a paged query. Currently, only the GmtCreateTime field is supported
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的排序字段。目前使用GmtCreateTime字段用于排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. The returned list contains only the models in the specified workspace. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 配置工作空间ID，返回列表中只获取该工作空间内的模型列表。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The model name. This parameter is used to filter the model list
parameters.help_zh: 配置模型名称，用来过滤获取的模型列表
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The label string. This parameter is used to filter the list. Models are returned if their label keys or values contain the specified string
parameters.help_zh: 标签串。用于列表过滤，标签中key或value中，有指定字符串的，都会被过滤出来
parameters.name: label

parameters.help_en: The provider. If you specify a provider, only the public models from that provider are returned. If you leave this parameter empty, your own models are returned
parameters.help_zh: 提供者。指定提供者，则只返回该提供者公开的模型。不填则返回用户自己的模型
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The domain. This parameter is used to filter the model list by domain. Examples: nlp (natural language processing) and cv (computer vision)
parameters.help_zh: 配置领域来过滤该领域内的模型列表。例如：nlp（自然语言处理）、cv（计算机视觉）等
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The task. This parameter is used to filter the model list by task type. Example: text-classification
parameters.help_zh: 配置任务来过滤属于该任务类型的模型列表。例如：text-classification（文本分类）等
parameters.name: task

parameters.help_en: The model source. This parameter is used to filter the model list by community or organization. Examples: ModelScope and HuggingFace
parameters.help_zh: 配置模型源，来过滤属于该社区或组织的模型列表。例如ModelScope，HuggingFace等
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en: The query condition. This parameter performs a fuzzy match on ModelName, Domain, Task, LabelKey, and LabelValue. For example, if you enter nlp, models that match in any of these fields are returned
parameters.help_zh:
配置查询条件。ModelName、Domain、Task、LabelKey、LabelValue相似匹配。
例如输入为nlp，则ModelName、Domain、Task、LabelKey、LabelValue中匹配的模型都会返回
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The collections to which the model belongs. You can specify multiple collections. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 模型所在Collection，支持填写多个，用英文逗号分割
parameters.name: collections
